# SportLingo - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
SportLingo is a full-stack web application implementing a Duolingo-style sports/fitness gamification platform.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js with Express.js, TypeScript
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
- **Authentication**: JWT with bcrypt
